title: It actually works
body: I love this app. It’s gentle, thoughtful, and deeply satisfying. I look forward to the end of every day when I can check off each of the habits I’m working on. It’s helped me change habits more quickly and easily than any other app I’ve tried.
author: habitual hedgehog
